notes: Read all 58 numbered source lines before editing. alert-cooldown.ts is non-visual type/data code (an FSM definition: state union + entries, trigger/guard unions, a config interface, transition/edge/disallowed/coverage/scenario tables, and an aggregate FSMDefinition). It touches no DOM, no browser globals, no Recharts/Leaflet, and no web UI components, so it ports 1:1 to React Native-compatible TypeScript (contract rule 6).

L1-2 imports preserved verbatim: `import type { StateEntry, Edge, FSMDefinition, TransitionRow, DisallowedTransition, CoverageMatrix, Scenario } from './types'` and the value import `import { deriveEdges } from './types'`. `deriveEdges` is a runtime function (not type-only), so the sibling module must resolve at compile time.

Dependency `./types` did not yet exist in the native parity layer (no apps/native/src/web-parity/types/fsm/ directory). Following the established sibling-module precedent (apps/native/src/web-parity/api/types.ts exists as a real file rather than being inlined), web/src/types/fsm/types.ts was ported faithfully 1:1 to apps/native/src/web-parity/types/fsm/types.ts so the `from './types'` import resolves identically to the web. It is a pure, fully-portable TS module (BadgeVariant/StateStyle/StateEntry/Edge/FSMDefinition/TransitionRow/CoverageCell/CoverageMatrix/DisallowedTransition/Scenario/ToastMap/TruthTable types + deriveEdges/isValidTransition functions) with no DOM/browser/Recharts/Leaflet/web-UI dependencies. Inlining was rejected because ./types is shared by ~11 sibling fsm files and would duplicate deriveEdges across all of them (DRY).
L4-5 ALERT_COOLDOWN_STATES `['armed','fired','suppressed'] as const` and the `AlertCooldownState = (typeof ...)[number]` union ported verbatim.
L7-11 ALERT_COOLDOWN_STATE_ENTRIES ported verbatim: armed->{variant:'success'}, fired->{variant:'danger'}, suppressed->{variant:'warning'}. Record<AlertCooldownState, StateEntry> typing preserved.
